title: Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut by Namo Bharat: Route, Distance, Fare and Timings
description: Going from Sarai Kale Khan (Hazrat Nizamuddin) to Meerut? Explore the complete guide for a safe journey through Namo Bharat RRTS
body:
Travelling from Sarai Kale Khan in Delhi to Meerut used to mean two and a half to three hours stuck on NH-58 traffic. With Namo Bharat RRTS now fully operational, the same journey takes under an hour by train. Here is everything you need to know before you travel.

**Quick answer:** Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut by Namo Bharat covers approximately 82 km and takes around 50 to 60 minutes end to end. The fare for the full journey to Modipuram is ₹210 for Standard Coach and ₹250 for Premium Coach. Trains run daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

### Quick Facts: Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut

| Detail | Information |
| Distance | Approximately 82 km |
| Journey time | 50 to 60 minutes |
| Operating hours | 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily |
| Standard fare (to Modipuram) | ₹210 |
| Premium fare (to Modipuram) | ₹250 |
| Total stations en route | 13, including Sarai Kale Khan |
| Road travel time (for comparison) | 2.5 to 3 hours |

### Which Meerut Station Should You Get Off At?

This is worth clarifying first, since "Meerut" on this corridor is not a single stop. Namo Bharat has multiple stations inside Meerut, and picking the right one matters:

- [**Meerut South**](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/meerut-south.html) is the first Meerut station you reach, useful if you are headed to the outer parts of the city or connecting onward by road.
- [**Shatabdi Nagar**](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/shatabdi-nagar.html) sits closer to central residential areas.
- [**Begumpul** ](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/begumpul.html)is the most central station, close to Meerut's main market and commercial area, and is underground.
- [**Modipuram** ](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/modipuram.html)is the final stop on the current corridor, useful for the northern end of the city.

If someone just says "Meerut," they usually mean the city center, which is best reached via **Begumpul**, not the final terminus at Modipuram. Choosing the wrong stop can add significant local travel time, so it is worth deciding this before you book.

### Full Route: Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut Station by Station

The train departs Sarai Kale Khan and runs through Delhi, Ghaziabad, and into Meerut, stopping at:

New Ashok Nagar, Anand Vihar, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Guldhar, Duhai, Murad Nagar, Modi Nagar South, Modi Nagar North, Meerut South, Shatabdi Nagar, Begumpul, and finally Modipuram.

Anand Vihar and Begumpul are underground stations, the rest on this stretch run elevated above the road.

### Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut Fare Chart

These are official NCRTC fares for Standard and Premium Coach, verified as of February 2026.

| Destination in Meerut | Standard Fare | Premium Fare |
| Meerut South | ₹160 | ₹190 |
| Shatabdi Nagar | ₹180 | ₹215 |
| Begumpul | ₹200 | ₹240 |
| Modipuram | ₹210 | ₹250 |

Fares are distance based, so the closer Meerut station you choose, the less you pay. NCRTC can revise these fares periodically, so it is worth confirming on the Namo Bharat Connect app before you travel if it has been a while since this guide was updated.

### Namo Bharat Timings for This Route

Trains run daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, with departures roughly every 10 to 15 minutes. The first train from Sarai Kale Khan leaves around 6:00 AM, and the last train departs around 10:00 PM. If you are planning an early morning or late evening trip, it is a good idea to check the live schedule shortly before you leave, since frequency can shift slightly during off peak hours.

### How Much Time Does This Journey Actually Save?

By road, Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut typically takes two and a half to three hours depending on traffic, and can stretch longer during peak hours or on weekends. Namo Bharat covers the same distance in under an hour, which means you save roughly two hours each way. For daily commuters, that adds up to significant time saved over a work week, and for one-off trips it makes a same-day round trip to Meerut genuinely practical.

### How to Book Your Ticket

You have three simple options:

1. **Namo Bharat Connect app** — select Sarai Kale Khan as your origin and your Meerut station as destination, pay via UPI or card, and get a QR ticket instantly.
2. **NCMC card** — tap in at Sarai Kale Khan and tap out at your Meerut station, no need to book in advance.
3. **Ticket vending machines** — available at the station if you prefer paying on the spot.

### Tips for First Time Travellers on This Route

- Decide your exact Meerut station before boarding, since getting off at the wrong one means extra local travel.
- If you are connecting from Delhi Metro, Sarai Kale Khan connects with the Pink Line, so factor in a short walk between platforms.
- Premium Coach is worth considering on this specific route since it is a longer journey, closer to an hour, compared to shorter hops elsewhere on the network.
- Keep your NCMC card topped up if you expect to make this trip regularly, it is faster than buying a fresh ticket each time.

### Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut by Regular Train

Apart from Namo Bharat, Indian Railways also runs regular trains between Delhi and Meerut, departing mainly from Hazrat Nizamuddin, Delhi Cantt, and New Delhi stations, which are all a short distance from Sarai Kale Khan.

The fastest option here is the **Vande Bharat Express**, which covers Hazrat Nizamuddin to Meerut City in around 46 minutes to just over an hour, depending on the specific service. Beyond that, several regular express trains such as Yoga Express and other daily services also connect Delhi to Meerut City and Meerut Cantt, though these typically take anywhere from 1.5 to 3 hours depending on the train and number of stops.

A few things worth knowing if you are considering this option:

- Regular trains arrive at **Meerut City** or **Meerut Cantt** stations, not the same stations as Namo Bharat, so factor in local transport from there to your final destination.
- Seat availability can be limited on short notice, especially on faster trains like Vande Bharat, so advance booking is recommended.
- Fares vary by train class, generally starting lower than Namo Bharat Premium Coach but requiring more advance planning since these are scheduled trains rather than a frequent, walk-in service.

For most day-to-day travel, Namo Bharat remains faster and far more frequent, since Vande Bharat and other regular trains run only a few times a day, while Namo Bharat departs every 10 to 15 minutes throughout the day.

### Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut by Road

If you are driving or taking a bus, the road route from Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut runs primarily via **NH-58**, passing through Ghaziabad and Modinagar before reaching Meerut.

- **Distance by road:** Approximately 70 to 75 km
- **Travel time by car:** Around 2 to 2.5 hours in normal traffic, often stretching to 3 hours or more during peak hours or weekend traffic
- **Bus services:** State-run and private buses operate on this route, generally taking around 2.5 hours, with fares significantly lower than a private cab but with less predictable travel time due to traffic and multiple stops
- **Taxi or cab services:** Available through most ride-hailing apps, offering door-to-door convenience but at a higher cost and with travel time still dependent on road traffic

Road travel makes sense if your final destination isn't well connected to a Namo Bharat or railway station, or if you are travelling with a lot of luggage. For most other cases, especially anyone travelling during peak traffic hours, Namo Bharat remains the clearer choice given the time saved.

### Comparing All Three Options

| Mode | Distance | Travel Time | Frequency |
| Namo Bharat RRTS | 82 km | 50 to 60 minutes | Every 10 to 15 minutes |
| Vande Bharat / Regular Train | 60 to 75 km | 46 minutes to 3 hours | A few times daily |
| Road (car, bus, taxi) | 70 to 75 km | 2 to 3 hours | Anytime, subject to traffic |

For speed, frequency, and predictability, Namo Bharat is the strongest option for this route. Regular trains are worth considering only if you specifically need to reach Meerut City or Meerut Cantt station, and road travel remains useful mainly for flexibility or when your destination isn't near a rail line.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### **How far is Meerut from Sarai Kale Khan?**

The distance is approximately 82 km by Namo Bharat RRTS.

#### **How long does it take from Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut?**

The journey takes approximately 50 to 60 minutes by Namo Bharat, compared to 2.5 to 3 hours by road.

#### **What is the fare from Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut?**

Fares range from ₹160 Standard Coach to Meerut South, up to ₹210 Standard Coach for the full journey to Modipuram. Premium Coach costs roughly 20 percent more.

#### **Which station should I choose for central Meerut?**

Begumpul is the most central station in Meerut, closest to the main market and commercial areas.

#### **What time does the first train run from Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut?**

The first train departs around 6:00 AM, with the last train around 10:00 PM.

#### **Is there a direct train from Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut?**

Yes, Namo Bharat runs directly from Sarai Kale Khan to Meerut without requiring a change of train.
